prediction.explanation: Closing the middle stair portal preserves footprints and record counts but removes one native adjacency and reduces upper-stair renderer contributions at the first pose.
Lowering the middle tread ceiling reduces its static aperture and changes the view without changing XY geometry, floor area or portal adjacency.
Movement-blocking flags change a native movement constraint while the opaque rendered view and portal graph stay fixed. Runtime traversal remains untested.
A surface-shade intervention changes pixels while geometric continuity and aperture measurements remain invariant.
